versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "guaikei-all-platform-video-transcript" skill.
- Converts video/audio files or platform links (e.g., Douyin, Xiaohongshu) to clean, structured text; supports prompts for summarization, rewriting, quote extraction, splitting into scenes, translation, and more.
- Outputs are powered by Qianwen LLM for semantic understanding and content refinement, with removal of fillers, errors, and duplicates.
- Accepts both local files and public video URLs; main formats supported include mp4, mov, mkv, avi, webm, flv, mp3, m4a, wav.
- Provides command-line usage, error handling, privacy assurances, and transparent usage-based pricing.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for authentication; no data retained after processing.
